assign.request: Reviewer minion for /imagine/mag/: ten-second clarity test, primary interaction proof, layout check at 3440, resolve findings in-realm, land.
steps: check layout invariants at 3440 against critique row
re-shoot and verify zero console errors

log.msg: STRANGER (cold, 1280): a poster-style cover for a small magazine called The Column, issue 01 - a title, one line of teaser copy, a click to open the issue. MEANT (readme.md/page.js/description): a small magazine built entirely out of the column-layout system's own vocabulary, a demo you use rather than inspect. Gap: the genre reads fine (magazine cover, click to open) but the teaser sentence -- Seven labs, one row, and a page tree that agreed to lie down sideways -- was pure author-vocabulary poetry; nothing told a stranger the magazine's own topic is the very layout mechanism rendering it.

Primary interaction: the whole cover (.mag-cover-area, labelled OPEN THE ISSUE) is an <a> to contents/. ui-test plan mag-primary.json, 6 steps, watched .mag-cover/.mag-contents/.mag-cover-area: click shrinks the cover by exactly 791px (full to golden 38.2%) and opens Contents beside it with six numbered article cards, a read-count line and a colophon -- matches the label, zero console errors both before and after my edits. 'zero-size' flags on .mag-cover/.mag-contents are expected noise: those classes sit on Page wrapper nodes that are display:contents by design (core/Page column peers), not a real layout bug.

Layout at 3440 vs critique row (paging/critique REALMS, slug mag): '47% wide - 986px dead - depth 4 - scroll 1392/1392', weak: hero floats dead-centre with symmetric blank margins, alt: 'Docs three-region once articles exist, or pair Solo with a bleed background wash'. Status: articles now exist (6, built since the critique line was written) but the cover itself is still the same solo centred hero -- the alt's first half is moot (a magazine cover is not a docs page) and the % width is UNCHANGED by my fix, so the finding is STILL OPEN structurally. Applied the alt's second half instead: raised .mag-cover-area's resting --mag-veil fallback 0%->2% (mag.css) so the full-bleed margins read as a toned sheet instead of blank browser-white, ahead of the existing hover(4%)/active-ancestor(9-13%) tone ladder -- ordering preserved, golden-share widths (38.2%/20%) untouched. Caveat: this is a feel fix only, not a width fix; the 47%/986px numbers are the same after it. Other two invariants clean: no text exceeds the 40em --measure cap (verified computed max-width on an article

at 3440 = 720px = 40em at that column's fluid 18px base font, not a violation -- em-based cap scales with fluid type on purpose); nothing but full-bleed structural wrappers (app/pages/page-columns-row) sits at x:0, and mag.css already clamps every full-viewport-facing padding (cover padding, rule, title, note, enter all clamp()).

FIX 1 (highest value): issue.json top-level standfirst (cover) rewritten from 'Seven labs, one row, and a page tree that agreed to lie down sideways.' to 'Six short articles about the column layout this very page is built with.' -- plain, states the topic, keeps the self-reference that is the actual point of the piece. Caveat: assumed the self-referential hook (this magazine's subject is the very layout rendering it) is worth keeping rather than cutting for max plainness; undo by dropping the second clause if a reader still finds it circular.

FIX 2: issue.json top-level masthead (contents page, first line under the second click) rewritten from 'Six pieces on the column system, written out of what the labs actually measured...' to 'Six pieces about the column layout this magazine is built with. Read them in order, or pick one -- the row keeps everything you open.' -- drops 'the labs' (undefined insider term) and echoes the cover's new wording for consistency. Caveat: only issue.standfirst/issue.masthead touched; grepped both fields' only call sites (page.js cover, contents/page.js masthead) before editing, so no other page reads them.

FIX 3: mag.css .mag-cover-area resting background veil 0%->2% (see layout log above). Re-shot cold at 1280 and 3440 after all three fixes, re-ran the primary-interaction ui-test plan: same behaviour, zero console errors in both runs. issue.json validated as parseable JSON after edit.

PROPOSED (not applied, no core/ext touch needed but deferred as a bigger design pass than this review's budget): a genuine full-bleed treatment for the cover at ultra-wide (a large ghost '01' watermark, or a repeating hairline field reusing --line) so 3440's 986px dead margin reads as designed rather than merely toned. That is a visual-design iteration, not a text/label fix, and belongs with whoever next does a design pass on mag -- the 2% wash in FIX 3 is the safe placeholder.

assign.outcome:
**The cover's takeaway sentence was the barrier, not the magazine concept.** Cold, the poster-style cover already read as "a small magazine, click to open the issue" -- but the one line meant to say what it's *about* (`issue.json`'s `standfirst`/`masthead`) was author-vocabulary poetry ("Seven labs, one row, and a page tree that agreed to lie down sideways"). Rewrote both to the plain, true sentence: this magazine's own topic is the column layout it is built with -- same self-reference, none of the jargon.

**Fixed (3):**
- `issue.json` cover `standfirst` -> "Six short articles about the column layout this very page is built with."
- `issue.json` contents `masthead` -> matching plain wording, drops the undefined "the labs"
- `mag.css` `.mag-cover-area` resting `--mag-veil` 0%->2%, answering the [critique row](/imagine/paging/critique/)'s "986px dead, split evenly, mostly a picture" -- a feel fix (margins read as toned paper), not a width fix; the % used is unchanged and the finding stays open as a layout question.

**Verified:** primary interaction (click the cover -> Contents opens beside it, golden-share resize -791px, six numbered cards) proven with a ui-test plan before and after the edits, zero console errors both times; `issue.json` re-validated as parseable JSON; text measure and edge invariants at 3440 both clean (no text past the 40em `--measure` cap, nothing but structural wrappers at x:0).

**Proposed, not applied:** a genuine full-bleed visual treatment (ghost watermark / hairline field) for the 3440 dead margin -- a design-iteration task, not a text/label fix; left for whoever next does a design pass on mag, noted in [`doc/decisions.md`](/imagine/mag/doc/decisions/).
